name: lethal_shield_wall
description: boss-ai A9 exhaustion: seven 2/2 attackers against three 1/1 Divine Shield Taunts and a player at 9. F4 passes at the root (14 - 3 = 11) and one ply down (12 - 3 = 9), but no line is lethal: two hits per Taunt spend six of the seven attacks. The tree is about 400 nodes: `budgets.lethal_max_nodes` below that exhausts, the band 3 budget ends it with no leaf. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
